# Computing 13 × 7

I'll break this down step by step using the distributive property.

## Method: Split 13 into 10 + 3

**Step 1:** Multiply 10 by 7
$$10 \times 7 = 70$$

**Step 2:** Multiply 3 by 7
$$3 \times 7 = 21$$

**Step 3:** Add the two results together
$$70 + 21 = 91$$

## Verification: Add 13 seven times

$$\begin{array}{rl}
13 & \\
+13 & = 26 \\
+13 & = 39 \\
+13 & = 52 \\
+13 & = 65 \\
+13 & = 78 \\
+13 & = 91 \\
\end{array}$$

## Result

$$\boxed{13 \times 7 = 91}$$
